summary: Review C fails: Playwright's browser download was skipped, but forge render requires Chromium and no render run verifies the updated browser contract.
applicability_evidence: The spec covers dependency updates and the added audit-gate CLI contract; phase diff adds scripts/audit-gate.mjs and tests/audit-gate.test.ts and updates package.json, pnpm-lock.yaml, and pnpm-workspace.yaml.
The user-requested contracts include forge build/render/check, pnpm dev, vite build, package scripts, and the new audit-gate CLI.
blocking_findings: B-1 (Green, High, CLI/runtime): Playwright 1.65.1 was installed with PLAYWRIGHT_SKIP_BROWSER_DOWNLOAD=1 (jr-green-bdacfe54.log lines 75-76). forge render launches Chromium for every command except build/check (src/cli/forge.ts lines 195-207). The recorded Forge checks run build and check only, so the updated Playwright/browser pairing is not verified. A fresh install without a cached matching browser will make render fail before rendering. Run a render command in the supported install environment and record success, or document and enforce the required browser installation.
evidence: jr-green-bdacfe54.log lines 75-76 records Playwright 1.65.1 installed with PLAYWRIGHT_SKIP_BROWSER_DOWNLOAD=1 and no gate launches a browser.
src/cli/forge.ts lines 195-207 sets needsBrowser for every command except build/check and calls chromium.launch when true.
jr-green-bdacfe54.log lines 68-70 records only ./forge build rogue and ./forge build slime --fast; it provides no render evidence.

vite.config.ts lines 79-94 retains the forge-api plugin, dev server settings, and five Vite build inputs; Green log lines 65-67 reports vite build exit 0.
